verdict.rationale: First-party docs say all media modalities (audio, video, screen share) are available 'for a single rate', which implies a simple, uniform usage price. However, the evidence never states the unit (per attendee-minute or bandwidth), gives no actual price figures, and links to no pricing page, so a founder cannot yet model costs from it. Missing for 10: a published per-participant-minute or per-bandwidth price, a pricing page citation, confirmation that no sales contact is needed, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, usage pricing is published per participant-minute or per unit of bandwidth, so I can model cost without talking to sales

citations.quote: You can choose to implement some or all of the available media modalities (audio, video, and screen share) for a single rate.
